title: Drop on History
tagline: A decentralized platform on the Ethereum blockchain, Drop on History allows users to immortalize significant moments, events with their community. A community can show their appreciation to their previous owners by airdropping directly to the people.
description:
Claimable airdrops are boring and not the way its meant to be! Yes we said it!

So lets bring autonomous airdrop with historical data, which is provable onchain using Axiom's amazing zk-coprocessor. The project checks if the account has event held a NFT or Token of any specified sort, for a configurable amount of time. Weather the account currently holds it or not, the good will they gave towards the project earns them a free airdrop without them having to do any claim process. All this data, is proved using axiom, a zk-coprocessor for ethereum and this data can be used anywhere.
how_its_made: This is built using typescript sdk from axiom and Solidity for the smart contracts. A lot of debugging for the axiom v2 functions was required but ultimately the idea was completed with great suggestions from the devs and their timely response. Circuits were written in axioms zk-repl preview site and the code was used from the output.
